name: King Bob-omb
_why_scale: Size pass 2 (Nick: the model fills its template skeleton like the template's own; scale is only how much bigger or smaller than the template, since it also sets the strike zone): 1.40x Mario's in-game height (model height x the Wario sizescale row x scale; Mario = 1.0). Was 1.17: his model now fills Wario's skeleton like Wario's own (fit_height 1.0, was 1.15, so 1.17 left his strike zone 1.15x too small).

bat._why: King K. Rool's mace with red crown-jewel gems, x0.873 about the grip so it keeps its size when his scale went 1.17 -> 1.34: python scripts/bat_recolors.py king-bobomb

_why_template: Wario: his round body and short legs carry the Bob-omb body, and his foot bones carry the feet (King Boo has no legs)
_why_stats: Captain flag and Wario's star swing 7 (Phony Swing) set here: Wario's own row no longer has it (he isn't a captain). The menus name it "Kingly Kaboom" (star_move_labels.py). Star pitch 15 is his own Bob-omb Drop (scripts/pitch_bobomb_drop.py, docs/bobomb-drop.md; star_move_labels.PITCH_NAMES).
_why_balance: git-8a's balance pass (Nick): own stats; chemistry starts neutral (not the template's). Super Mario 64 Bob-omb Battlefield boss (Goombas, Koopas); King Boo is his co-captain; rival big shot Wario.
